info.name: Student ID - Credential Service
info.description: Credential lab3-0.4.2: run this collection in order through Gateway http://localhost:8090. Set a valid accessToken accepted by the team's Gateway in a private local environment; never commit tokens or keys. Creates a disposable credential, verifies CRUD/listing/deletion, then checks sanitized 400/404/405 errors using a generated non-real student-ID sentinel. Internal /status and database fault injection are not public Gateway routes and are not part of this collection. These requests do not prove image provenance or full shared-stack acceptance.

exec: pm.test('No server-side failure or false green', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));

variable.description: Disposable local test JWT. Set in a private local environment; keep this collection value empty.
Generated disposable redaction sentinel, never a real student ID.

exec: pm.test('Credential created with an ID', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.credentialId).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i); pm.expect(body.type).to.eql('STUDENT_ID'); pm.collectionVariables.set('credentialId', body.credentialId); });

pm.test('Credential updated', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.credentialId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('credentialId')); pm.expect(body.type).to.eql('UNIVERSITY_EMAIL'); pm.expect(body.fields.email).to.eql('student@isa.utm.md'); });

pm.test('Applicant listing contains created credential', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().credentials.some(c => c.credentialId === pm.collectionVariables.get('credentialId'))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Invalid ID returns safe 400', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.error.code).to.eql('INVALID_REQUEST'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('path'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('auditStudentId')); pm.expect(body.error.traceId).to.eql(pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id')); });

pm.test('Missing route returns safe 404', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.error.code).to.eql('ROUTE_NOT_FOUND'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('path'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('auditStudentId')); });

pm.test('Method remains 405 with sanitized envelope', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(405); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED'); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).not.to.have.property('path'); });
